title: Breach engineer — research label
hook: Spend scarce expedition power on a safer fight, a route advantage or extraction while weapon/device builds change how the same machinery can be used.
audience: Players seeking third-person action, environmental tactics, exploration and consequential expedition choices.
core_loop: Scout a partially powered ruin, choose route and power allocation, fight with guns and deployables, disrupt machinery/enemy components, take a signposted security risk, extract and restore persistent workshop functions.
score_notes: Provisional indirect anchors only. This is an owner-fit/mechanics inspiration pass, not a market or trend study. Fun is untested; originality is limited by comparators; exact production/animation cost and distribution response are unmeasured. Ranking in the research report is qualitative and does not select a game.

evidence.claim: Developer describes gun/spell expeditions, exploration, extraction and persistent arsenal development; Early Access and our own untested implementation limit inference.
Developer describes FPS combat, boss cores, build enhancers and tower reward/trap manipulation; a close originality challenge for our proposals, not sales evidence.
Developer listing describes interacting run items, varied survivor kits and unlockable rules; a design reference, not guaranteed replay for our proposal.

risks: Can become obligatory switch pressing instead of tactical agency.
Saveable machinery states, altered navigation and interaction combinations create significant QA work.
Combat energy and route power must be distinct enough to avoid softlocks or confusing chores.
next_test: A representative freight district with alternative power routes, useful weapon/deployable choices, jammer/pursuer combinations, optional risk, security finale, extraction and saved workshop/access progress.
decision_reason: Third-ranked research alternative; appealing systemic exploration but greatest risk of chore-like interactions. No game selected.
engine_direction: Unreal5.8.2; full3D first-/third-person according to the candidate
scope_note: Substantially greater ambition; no literal10x multiplier, feature quota or hard development/owner-time cap. Counts and final campaign length are not selected.

prototype_envelope.scope: A representative freight district with alternative power routes, useful weapon/deployable choices, jammer/pursuer combinations, optional risk, security finale, extraction and saved workshop/access progress.

commercial_hypothesis: Unassessed in this inspiration pass; no price, sales forecast or acquisition expenditure selected.
title_note: Descriptive internal research label; naming/originality clearance not performed.

procedural_generation.direction: Designed 3D encounter modules with generated routes, compatible room configurations, encounters, objectives and rewards under playability and pacing constraints.
procedural_generation.next_test_refinement: Replay multiple generated versions of the representative biome; compare tactics, build choices, fairness and replay interest. Verify seed reproduction, save/resume, dependencies and actual in-engine traversal.
procedural_generation.evidence: Design proposal only; generator and procedural gameplay unimplemented and untested. Candidate remains draft.

decision_history.reason: Third-ranked research alternative; appealing systemic exploration but greatest risk of chore-like interactions. No game selected.
